answer: A bridge admits an operator's next identity only through as many sponsors as the operator will hold after admission, no two sharing work history with the operator or each other. Each sponsor must show a tide of N attested epochs and burn one shale. A tenth identity needs ten fresh outsiders, so ten identities cost 55 sponsors and 55 shale; a first costs one sponsor and one shale. The bridge records the sponsor set against the operator and a replacement bridge reopens it, so splitting the set only adds sponsors.
